content_sections.body: Use this lesson language to communicate a simple real-life meaning: Place always, usually, sometimes, and never with familiar actions. Model: “Linh usually reads after class, but she never studies on the bus.” Notice the important words and the word order. Mẹo tiếng Việt: hãy hiểu ý của cả câu trước, rồi nói theo cụm ngắn; không cần dịch từng từ.
content_sections.title: Form and meaning

content_sections.body: Read this short situation. A learner needs to use how often in class clearly and politely. One useful response is: “Linh usually reads after class, but she never studies on the bus.” Say the model once, then change one safe detail such as a name, place, time, colour, or item when the meaning allows.
content_sections.title: Guided context

content_sections.body: Practise for meaning, not only for memory. Imagine one everyday situation where how often in class is useful. First use the model, then make one small change. Check: Is the message clear? Is the target language in the right place? Can another person answer you?

speaking.instruction: Roleplay: you are a learner using how often in class; the tutor is a helpful conversation partner. Scenario: you need to use this language in a short everyday interaction. Tutor opening: “Hello. Can we practise how often in class?” Reply naturally, ask or answer one follow-up question, and finish the exchange politely. Useful model: Linh usually reads after class, but she never studies on the bus.
